editorial_changes: Removed absolute local working directories and operational history; preserved the complete mathematical arguments and their limitations.
Distinguished original assumption exponent -2022 from the separate target exponent -2024.
Kept historical hashes as provenance; current public-file hashes are recorded separately in MANIFEST.json.
Made check scripts portable with an explicit output argument and a local-manifest integrity check instead of an absolute candidate path.
Historical receipts are byte-preserved. Rerun receipts are separately named; exact algebra and numerical regressions are distinguished.
Elevated both exact T2/T3 maximum-length inequalities, fixed .0005 profile width, and opposite reflected/unreflected shifts; copied the authoritative review tail proof into the public proof.
Clarified that global completion cannot identify the original left complement alone: the globally completed right contribution is also retained. No new complementary-region theorem is included.
Added an explicit profile-width field to the author checker illustration; the historical receipt is unaltered.
